title: Godot 4.5.1 - Android : Small number of crashes with Exception java.lang.IllegalStateException: The specified child already has a parent.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5 and 4.5.1 stable
- Not seen in 4.4 (but low number of users)

### System information

Android 11 (SDK 30), Android 10 (SDK 29), Android 8.1 (SDK 27), Android 7.0 (SDK 24)

### Issue description

We are experimenting a few crashes with the following stacktraces, could not reproduce them locally.
We verified are are indeed in Godot 4.5.1 since October 20 2025, as we hoped https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109764 would help but it didn't.

A few stacktraces :

Maybe something that is relevant is we are using 'standard' launch mode in our manifest, (this was to prevent the game to restart if we were to put it in background and then click on the game icon instead of putting it in foreground with task manager) :
```
android:launchMode="standard"
```

We are in Compatibility rendering mode and stopped using GPU Particles 2D (as it caused SIGSEGV on older devices)

The number of crashes reported in Google Play Console is quite small (and few times larger in Firebase Crashlytics). Even with this we are lower than recommended threshold so it is not a major issue for now for us, just an inconvenience.

### Steps to reproduce

- We have a few ViewGroup.addViewInner issues each time we submit our application on Google Play Store reported on Firebase Crashlytics on a OnePlus8Pro on Android 11 (not showing on Play Store Crashes and ANR section)
- We also see (a few) crashes reported on play store crashes and ANR section :( with the same exception, here are two stacktraces
